extract_experiment_settings: extracts/summarizes experimental settings from academic papers, including datasets, metrics, baselines, configurations, and so on. *NOTE*: not include any experimental results.
extract_experiment_setups: extract/summarizes **ONLY** the experimental environment and key parameters settings from academic papers
extract_experiment_baselines: extracts/summarizes experimental baselines (compared methods) from academic papers
extract_experiment_datasets: extracts/summarizes datasets used in experiments from academic papers
extract_experiment_metrics: extracts/summarizes evaluation metrics used in experiments from academic papers
extract_ablation_studies: extracts/summarizes ablation studies from academic papers, including the ablation method, results, and analysis
extract_parameter_studies: extracts/summarizes parameter studies from academic papers, including the parameter names, values, and results
extract_experiment_results: extracts/summarizes experimental results from academic papers, including method names, metrics, results
extract_proposed_methods: extracts/summarizes proposed methods (main idea) from academic papers, including method names, method summaries, and method pros and cons
extract_problem_definition: extracts/summarizes problem definitions from academic papers, including input, output, and goal of the research problem
extract_problem_input: extracts/summarizes input data of the research problem from academic papers
extract_problem_output: extracts/summarizes output data of the research problem from academic papers
extract_problem_goal: extracts/summarizes goal of the research problem from academic papers
rank_datasets: ranks/summarizes the datasets used in a paper based on the performance of methods on each dataset, as measured by the evaluation metrics.
rank_variants: ranks/summarizes the performance of method variants based on experimental results, including method names, metrics, and results.
summarize_parameter_impact: sumarizes the impact of parameters introduced in one paper based on the experiment results.
check_inconsistencies_on_metrics: checks for inconsistencies between evaluation metrics used in a paper's experimental section and their original definitions
rank_performance_cross_papers: ranks/summarizes the performance of methods across multiple papers based on the evaluation metrics and datasets used in the experiments.
summarize_common_settings_cross_papers: summaries the common experimental settings across multiple papers, including datasets, metrics, baselines.
summarize_methods_cross_papers: summaries/compares the methods proposed in multiple papers, including method names, method summaries, and method pros and cons.
summarize_missing_experiment_settings_cr: summaries the missing experimental settings across multiple papers, including datasets, metrics, baselines, and so on. *NOTE*: not include any experimental results.
compare_problem_definitions_cross_papers: compares/summarizes the problem definitions across multiple papers, including input, output, and goal of the research problem.
check_insconsistencies_on_experiment_res: checks for inconsistencies in experimental results across multiple papers on shared dataset-metric pairs, highlighting discrepancies and potential causes.
